title: Git Slides deck
description: Input format accepted by git-slides.mjs. The generator converts this JSON into one self-contained HTML slideshow.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for editor validation.

title.description: Deck title used in the browser tab and top bar. Falls back to 'Git Slides'.

subtitle.description: Optional deck subtitle shown next to the title in the top bar.

maxDiffLines.description: Default maximum diff units per page before a diff is split. Values outside 8-80 are clamped by the generator.

slides.description: Ordered slides rendered into the HTML deck.

color.description: CSS color accepted by the generator's sanitizer. Invalid values fall back to the default theme.

maxLines.description: Maximum diff lines/units per generated page.

markdownString.description: Markdown text. Supports headings, paragraphs, lists, blockquotes, fenced code, tables, links, inline code, bold, italic, and strikethrough.

theme.description: Optional theme colors injected as CSS variables.

diffEntry.description: One unified diff shown as a card on the right side of a split slide.

path.description: File path shown in the diff header. Used as the fallback when the raw diff has no file header.

diff.description: Raw unified diff text. May contain one or more `diff --git` sections; additions/deletions and line numbers are parsed from it.

title.description: Slide title. Falls back to the deck title when omitted.

meta.description: Optional metadata chips rendered below the subtitle.

markdownSlide.description: Full-width markdown slide. `content` is the body text; `title`, `eyebrow`, and `description` form the heading block.

align.description: Content alignment. Omitted or 'left' uses the default left-aligned layout.

splitSlide.description: Markdown on the left, one or more diff cards on the right. Long diffs paginate automatically; each page repeats the markdown.

markdown.description: Left-hand markdown body. `content` is accepted as an alias.

content.description: Alias for `markdown`, useful when reusing notes from a full-width slide.

diffs.description: Diff cards stacked in the right-hand column.

diff.description: Convenience single diff string when `diffs` is omitted.

path.description: Convenience header path used with `diff` or as the fallback for `diffs` entries.

diffSlide.description: Full-width diff slide without a left markdown column. Kept for decks that need one large diff.

path.description: File path shown in the diff header. Used as the fallback when the raw diff has no file header.

examples.subtitle: A compact review of one pull request

slides.markdown: The database already knows which runs are active. Add one bulk query and expose it.
